Scegli Fcinter1908.it come tuo sito preferito su Google: clicca qui.

Intervenuto ai microfoni de La Stampa, Massimo Ambrosini ha parlato anche della Lazio di Gattuso che affronterà il Torino di Abate, due suoi ex compagni in rossonero.

Da commentatore di Dazn, che trasmetterà la partita, quale duello vedremo tra questi due amici?

Recent findings suggest that �Il Toro deve fare una partita coraggiosa perché gioca in casa e può dare una svolta, quindi mi aspetto una prova gagliarda da parte di una squadra che non si spaventerà di affrontare la capolista. La Lazio, invece, giocherà come sempre: vorrà fare la partita, attaccando con tanti uomini. Rino ha già fatto vedere che cambiano gli avversari, ma non la sua idea di calcio».

Recent findings suggest that la Lazio è la sorpresa più grande di questa Serie A. Come ha fatto Gattuso a portarla in vetta da imbattuta?

�Rino lo conosco bene e conosco la capacità che ha di far giocare le proprie squadre. Al di là della Nazionale, una parentesi molto particolare anche per gli uomini che aveva a disposizione, Milan e Napoli giocavano un bel calcio con lui. È la sua storia che lo racconta e la gente ha la memoria corta... Poi da lì a pensare che una squadra nella situazione in cui era la Lazio, con tutto quello che gli gira intorno, potesse fare questo tipo di percorso... Non se lo aspettava neanche lui, ma è giusto che sia primo per quel che sta facendo in campo».

�C'era una base solida, ma l'empatia creata da Gattuso e i principi di gioco hanno fatto la differenza».

Gattuso ha saputo rigenerare gente che sembrava persa...

�La testa è fondamentale, ma non basta. Gattuso ha saputo tirare fuori il meglio da Isaksen, Frattesi o Taylor perché ha dato le conoscenze giuste per farli sentire in fiducia: così riesci a sfruttare il potenziale tecnico e atletico di ognuno».

Recent findings suggest that il Toro, invece, è ancora una squadra indecifrabile. Sconta il noviziato di Abate?

�Per l'organico che ha, non so quanto possa ambire a fare un campionato di un livello superiore. E non penso che per Ignazio sia questione di scontare la categoria: un progetto tecnico, all'interno di un cambiamento, può subire alti e bassi. La sensazione, però, è di un gruppo unito che segue l'allenatore. Per fare un passo in avanti serve stabilità e il Toro la sta ancora cercando».

Da capitano, che giocatore era Abate in quel Milan?

�Ignazio era propositivo, ma era anche un buon incassatore: sia dal punto di vista pratico, visti gli scappellotti che riceveva, ma anche dialettico».

Con Gattuso e Abate avete vinto lo scudetto...

In a recent development, �Arrivò in una fase di transizione, prendendo la coda di una squadra che aveva vinto tantissimo in Europa, ma ha assorbito intelligentemente certi valori. Conosco bene sua mamma e suo papà: l'hanno cresciuto predisponendolo a tutto questo ed era un compagno eccezionale perché aveva un modo speciale di affrontare la vita e gli allenamenti».

Che cosa la sta colpendo della sua nuova vita da tecnico?

�Fin dal vivaio del Milan i feedback erano super positivi: si percepiva da come parlava di calcio, dalle domande che faceva e il modo in cui si predisponeva a confrontarsi».

Vede somiglianze con Gattuso, anche lui partito dalle giovanili rossonere?

According to recent reports, �Entrambi hanno una predisposizione al coraggio: magari nel Toro si è visto un po' meno nell'ultimo periodo, però sono allenatori con idee chiare e con la voglia comunque di osare. L'importante è avere una struttura solida, altrimenti il coraggio diventa un'arma a doppio taglio».

Abate nel 2019 ha chiuso la carriera da giocatore nel Milan allenato da Gattuso. Un giorno guiderà i rossoneri?

�Non so, è troppo avanti col tempo. Come allenatore si sta facendo le ossa, ma non diamo giudizi affrettati».

  • Industry observers note that "La S.S.
  • Arezzo comunica di aver affidato la guida tecnica della Prima Squadra a Fabio Caserta.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Recent findings suggest that continuano i cambi di panchina in Serie B con il turno infrasettimanale che ha mietuto un'altra vittima nella giornata appena passata. L'Arezzo ha infatti annunciato l'esonero del tecnico Cristian Bucchi, protagonista della promozione dalla Serie C, e la nomina di Fabio Caserta come suo successore. Quest'ultimo esordirà dunque in panchina allo Stadio Città di Arezzo nel derby contro il Pisa di domenica sera.

Industry observers note that "La S.S. Arezzo comunica di aver sollevato dall’incarico di allenatore della Prima Squadra mister Cristian Bucchi e i componenti del suo staff tecnico. La società desidera ringraziare mister Bucchi e i suoi collaboratori per il lavoro svolto in amaranto, per la professionalità, la dedizione e l’impegno dimostrati nel corso della loro esperienza ad Arezzo. Il nome di mister Bucchi resterà legato a una delle pagine più importanti della storia recente del club, culminata con la vittoria del campionato e il ritorno dell’Arezzo in Serie B, traguardo raggiunto attraverso un percorso sportivo capace di coinvolgere squadra, società e tifoseria".

Sources indicate that "La S.S. Arezzo comunica di aver affidato la guida tecnica della Prima Squadra a Fabio Caserta. Il tecnico ha sottoscritto un contratto fino al 30 giugno 2028 e nel pomeriggio dirigerà il suo primo allenamento al Centro Sportivo “Giusy Conti” di Rigutino, iniziando ufficialmente la propria avventura sulla panchina amaranto".

"Caro Arezzo, in questo momento dove la ragione è sopraffatta da emozioni contrastanti è il mio cuore a parlare. Èda ieri che ricevo una marea di messaggi di vicinanza, vorrei abbracciarvi tutti. - è il saluto di Bucchi dai suoi profili social - Ad Arezzo ho ritrovato la voglia e l‘entusiasmo di fare calcio e una tifoseria che sin dal primo giorno mi ha sempre dimostrato stima ed affetto capendo ed apprezzando l'uomo prima dell'allenatore. Un gruppo di ragazzi unici che ho avuto il piacere di allenare e che non smetterò mai di ringraziare per l'incredibile magia che siamo riusciti a creare insieme. Non vi dimenticherò mai. Rimarrà una delle pagine più belle della mia carriera calcistica. Infinitamente Grazie".

Industry observers note that “Prima di tutto voglio ringraziare Bucchi per quello che ci ha dato in questi due anni e per l’uomo che è. Ci ha fatto molto male doverci separare, ma il calcio ha delle regole non scritte che vanno in qualche modo affrontate. La scelta è stata dolorosissima però bisognava, come ho spiegato a lui, che ampiamente ha capito dare una svolta. - sono le parole del presidente Guglielmo Manzo - Caserta mi è sempre piaciuto come allenatore e due anni fa provammo a portarlo qui da noi, ma ovviamente lui voleva continuare a mantenere la Serie B. Questa volta abbiamo alzato il telefono e in dieci secondi ci siamo messi d’accordo perché la volontà di fare un percorso assieme era tanta. È stata l’unica telefonata che abbiamo fatto”.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

By Saikat Mandal | 26 Nov 2026 08:21.

Manchester United reportedly remain open to selling Marcus Rashford in January if they receive a suitable offer for the forward.

Rashford spent last season on loan at Barcelona, and it appeared that his future lay away from Old Trafford after he fell out with former manager Ruben Amorim.

Man Utd publicly backed his reintegration into the squad after Barcelona opted against signing him permanently, but the England international has so far cut a disappointing figure.

Rashford has made six Premier League appearances this season, starting four of them, but is yet to register a goal or assist.

With Mauricio Pochettino looking to reshape the attacking line-up in his own image, Rashford could once again find himself facing an uncertain future.

Speaking on the Market Madness podcast, transfer expert Ben Jacobs has suggested that the Red Devils would still consider suitable offers for Rashford.

The forward remains under contract at United until 2028, meaning the club are under no immediate pressure to sell him.

At the same time, the Red Devils could consider letting him leave as they look to add depth and quality to their forward department in January or potentially next summer.

It has been revealed that rashford is presently sidelined with a hip injury and missed both of Pochettino's first two games in charge. However, the club expect him to return before the end of the month, potentially in time for the clash against Brentford.

Joshua Zirkzee came on at half-time against Liverpool, but there is a strong possibility that the Dutch striker could be offloaded, with several Serie A clubs reportedly keen on his signature.

Pochettino also needs to reshape his defence, with signing a fresh centre-back a priority, potentially putting Lisandro Martinez's future at the club in doubt.

There are also doubts over the long-term future of captain Bruno Fernandes, who has already rejected two contract offers from the club.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

By TOM COLLOMOSSE, FOOTBALL REPORTER.

Published: 17:00 EST, 24 November 2026 | Updated: 17:05 EST, 24 November 2026.

Alejandro Garnacho's future at Aston Villa was plunged into further doubt on Tuesday as he was overlooked for their defeat at Galatasaray.

The Argentine joined on loan from Chelsea last summer with a £43million obligation to buy, triggered when certain targets were hit.

Yet Garnacho has yet to start for Villa and was not even on the bench in Istanbul, even though two goalkeepers were named.

Asked whether Garnacho was fit for this match, Villa boss Unai Emery stated: 'Today I think the best players to play with us, to be with us, were here.'.

Daily Mail Sport has reported regularly this season that Garnacho may not see out his loan spell and now that looks increasingly likely to be the case.

There is not thought to be a break clause in the loan but if Chelsea and Villa agreed to cancel it, that would allow Garnacho to go elsewhere in January.

Alejandro Garnacho was not in the Aston Villa squad for their defeat at Galatasaray on Tuesday.

Villa boss Unai Emery chose to include two goalkeepers on his bench instead of picking of him.

Villa had a similar situation with Harvey Elliott. The midfielder joined on loan from Liverpool in summer 2025 but barely played.

Emery decided rapidly that he did not want to sign Elliott permanently and could not risk triggering the appearance clause that would have seen him join Villa for £35m.

Sources indicate that villa are now without a win in six and Emery admitted: 'The next challenge against PSG at home will be huge. If we can recover the three points we lost today maybe we still have a chance to reach the top eight but we are not favourites.'.

Emery also bemoaned the home side's time-wasting tactics after Deniz Gul headed them into a 77th-minute lead.

He remarked: 'I am not blaming the referee but he was unfair with us by adding only five minutes. After they scored it was impossible to play.'.

By Ben Knapton | 26 Nov 2026 08:36.

Seeking to surge nine points clear of Manchester City at the top of the Premier League table, Arsenal welcome Enzo Maresca's men to the Emirates Stadium for Sunday's main event.

The Gunners were not punished for dropping points in their 2-2 draw with Newcastle United last weekend, thanks to the Sky Blues' own slip-up against Fulham and Brighton & Hove Albion's shock loss at Hull City.

The champions therefore sit six points clear of both blue-clad rivals after 11 matches, but the Emirates faithful experienced draw deja vu in Tuesday's 1-1 stalemate with Borussia Dortmund in the Champions League.

Here, Sports Mole rounds up all of Arsenal's latest injury and suspension news for their clash with Man City, who also had to settle for a point in Europe last time out, being held to a 2-2 draw at home to Napoli.

In a recent development, possible return date: November 29 (vs. Manchester City).

David Raya appeared to have done serious damage to his shoulder when he was taken off against Newcastle, but Arsenal's number one has avoided a major injury and will not require surgery.

Arteta has not ruled him out of Sunday's game just yet, but he is facing a race against time to prove his fitness.

Possible return date: December 20 (vs. Manchester United).

Bukayo Saka suffered a severe quadriceps injury in October's 2-2 Champions League draw with Bayern Munich, and the England international will not return to action until just before Christmas in the best-case scenario.

In a recent development, possible return date: December 20 (vs. Manchester United).

Martin Zubimendi pulled his hamstring during Spain's Nations League defeat to England earlier this month, and like Saka, the midfielder faces another few weeks in the medical bay.

Arsenal have no players suspended for this game, as Max Dowman has now completed a three-match ban following his red card against Fleetwood Town in the EFL Cup.

Sources indicate that tiene sempre banco in casa Manchester United la situazione legata a Bruno Fernandes. Il capitano dei Red Devils è in scadenza di contratto con il Milan che sarebbe comunque alla finestra, interessato a far tornare in Italia il giocatore. Secondo quanto riporta l’edizione odierna del The Athletic, la società inglese ha esercitato l'opzione per prolungare di un anno il contratto e quindi con scadenza nel 2028. La decisione arriva dopo che l’ex Udinese e Sampdoria aveva confermato la sospensione dei colloqui per un nuovo contratto, con entrambe le parti intenzionate a concentrarsi sul miglioramento dei risultati in campo.

It has been revealed that una decisione che impedirà così ai club interessati di dialogare col giocatore già da gennaio per poi perderlo a zero. Ciò non toglie però che Bruno Fernandes lasci lo United a fine stagione con diversi club europei, fra cui appunto i rossoneri, e dell'Arabia Saudita interessati.

E proprio sul giocatore, oggi Mauricio Pochettino ha parlato: "Non sappiamo ancora nulla. È alle prese con un virus preso in Portogallo. Ha terminato l'ultima partita accusando qualche problema e oggi non ha potuto prendere parte all'allenamento. Vedremo. Monitoreremo la situazione nel corso della giornata e domani, in base a come si sveglierà. Non correremo alcun rischio: in casi del genere, sai bene che non è il caso di forzare. Presteremo molta attenzione, ma per ora non abbiamo ancora deciso nulla".

Il giornalista guarda al rendimento del club negli ultimi vent’anni e considera la Roma la principale rivale dell’Inter.

Sources indicate that fabio Ravezzani elogia Claudio Lotito per il rendimento della Lazio negli ultimi vent’anni e definisce appassionante la squadra, sorpresa del campionato. Secondo quanto riportato da TuttoMercatoWeb, Il giornalista, intervenuto in radio, ritiene però che sia la Roma a poter dare più fastidio all’Inter.

CLICCA QUI E SEGUI LAZIOPRESS.IT ANCHE SU INSTAGRAM.

Ravezzani considera Torino e Atalanta avversarie abbordabili per i biancocelesti e si aspetta ulteriori risposte dal derby. Sulla Lazio osserva: «La Lazio comunque è il motivo per cui noi amiamo follemente questo sport. Era una squadra senza pubblico, con giocatori considerati inadeguati e che aveva preso in quel momento secondo molti il peggior allenatore possibile. Non credo che durerà lì davanti, ma finora continua a rimanere in alto.».

Il giornalista passa quindi al lavoro del presidente: «Alla fine dei conti bisogna dire che Lotito è un grande presidente, perché se guardo la storia del club negli ultimi vent'anni vedo una società che e riuscita ad avere un rendimento adeguato alla sua dimensione, talvolta anche superiore».

Nonostante l’apprezzamento per la Lazio, Ravezzani indica nei giallorossi la squadra più capace di mettere in difficoltà l’Inter: «Con tutto il rispetto per la Lazio credo che sia la Roma la squadra che può dare più fastidio all'Inter. I romanisti volevano un riferimento e Gasperini, che nulla avrebbe a che spartire con l'ambiente Roma, ha messo in piedi una squadra che finalmente mette in mostra le qualità che aveva e che nell'era Moriunho erano state un po' nascoste».

Scegli Fcinter1908.it come tuo sito preferito su Google: clicca qui.

Nel corso del podcast Tre Uomini e una Capra di Controcalcio, Riccardo Trevisani, giornalista, ha parlato così dell'Inter di Cristian Chivu: "L'Inter, al di là della problematica tattica che può avere in alcune partite e in altre no, perché in alcune partite va sotto per 2-0 e poi vince 5-2, vuol dire che in quello spezzone vince 5-0, sa fare anche spezzoni in cui non è in difficoltà. Ma qual è il problema reale? Che la maggior parte delle volte entra in campo a volte pensando di aver vinto senza scendere in campo: e tante volte si addormenta, fa tipo la Bella Addormentata nel Bosco e prende gol stupidissimi, non tattici e tecnici, di cervello.

Recent findings suggest that non è arroganza. Il paragone tra Chivu e Inzaghi? 15 anni di carriera contro uno e un pezzo: Simone è partito prima e ha fatto cose gigantesche. Ribadisco: l'Inter due finali di Champions in tre anni fa fatica a rivederle. Non perché non sia forte, ma perché lo spending non va di pari passo con Real e Bayern. Ha fatto un miracolo e non gli si rende merito perché le ha perse contro squadre che ogni anno fatturano mille miliardi con l'Inter che faceva ogni anno -700 ed è arrivata a 0 per merito di Inzaghi. Il che non vuol dire che Chivu non sia bravo: va valutato sul lungo periodo. Pronti via ha vinto campionato e Coppa Italia e lotta per tutto: io tutte ste critiche non le capisco, il che non vuol dire che l'Inter non abbia problemi e sia perfetta.

Recent findings suggest that ho paragonato l'Inter 2020-26 alla Juve 2011-19? Ho detto che in questi due spezzoni l'Inter, secondo me, per diversi anni, specialmente da Inzaghi in avanti, ha espresso una qualità di calcio migliore: la Juve ha giocato bene con Conte e quando aveva Cuadrado, Dybala e Mandzukic davanti. Ma nei nove anni spesso vinceva 1-0 con partite molto noiose: poi ha fatto degli exploit, sulla qualità di gioco è meglio l'Inter. Ma io stavo dicendo che l'Inter di questi sei anni ha carenze giganti di personalità e di saper soffrire: mentre quella Juve straordinaria non le aveva queste mancanze. La Juve era molto superiore dal punto di vista della leadesrship dei calciatori: questo ho detto, poi la gente su internet taglia gli spezzoni, fa i click, le sub, i cazzi e i mazzi...".

By Ben Knapton | 26 Nov 2026 08:54, Last updated: 27 Nov 2026 14:47.

On the hunt for a fifth win in six Premier League matches, Tottenham Hotspur head north to battle Sunderland at the Stadium of Light on Sunday afternoon.

Roberto De Zerbi's men consigned their Leeds United loss to the past last weekend, easing past Ipswich Town 2-0 courtesy of goals from young star Luca Williams-Barnett and Dominic Solanke.

The Lilywhites have returned to the top half of the Premier League table as a result, and De Zerbi now seeks a slice of revenge after suffering a 1-0 defeat to Sunderland in his Tottenham debut last season.

Here, Sports Mole rounds up all of Tottenham's latest injury and suspension news ahead of their meeting with the Black Cats, who are 18th in the rankings with nine points from 11 games.

Possible return date: November 29 (vs. Sunderland).

Sandro Tonali was absent from last Saturday's win over Ipswich due to illness, but he has returned to Tottenham training and is expected to be available for the weekend.

Possible return date: November 29 (vs. Sunderland).

While Tonali might return from a bug, Lucas Bergvall has now fallen sick and is more of a doubt for gameweek 12.

Savio returned from a muscular injury as a second-half substitute against Ipswich, but the Brazilian attacker then had to come off with a similar problem towards the end.

Reports have now stated that Savio faces several weeks on the sidelines, and De Zerbi confirmed on Friday that he is not expecting him back for a while.

Possible return date: November 29 (vs. Sunderland).

Tosin Adarabioyo had made a full recovery from a calf injury before last weekend's triumph, but he was not risked by De Zerbi.

However, if the defender can prove his fitness this week, he should be in the matchday squad at the Stadium of Light.

Sources indicate that possible return date: December 6 (vs. Arsenal).

Chelsea loanee Mykhaylo Mudryk is still on the mend from an ankle injury, and the Ukrainian is not expected to return to action for another couple of weeks.

Possible return date: February 20 (vs. Brighton & Hove Albion).

Xavi Simons is almost seven months into his recovery from an ACL rupture, and all being well, the Dutchman could make his comeback in mid to late February.

In a recent development, possible return date: February 6 (vs. Ipswich Town).

Likewise, Wilson Odobert will not play again in 2026 due to his own serious knee injury, but De Zerbi is hopeful that the winger will return to full training in January ahead of a potential February return.

Possible return date: December 6 (vs. Arsenal).

De Zerbi revealed last week that Mathys Tel will need another "two or three weeks" to recover from the ankle injury he picked up against Leeds, so the Frenchman could be targeting a comeback for the North London derby on December 6.

Tottenham have no players banned for this game.

A due giorni dalla trasferta di Reggio Emilia, Kevin De Bruyne non ha lavorato insieme al resto dei compagni, svolgendo lavoro differenziato a causa di un affaticamento muscolare. Il centrocampista belga ha finora collezionato 17 presenze, 4 gol e 2 assist in tutte le competizioni, per un totale di 1.135 minuti giocati.

Industry observers note that le condizioni del centrocampista belga saranno valutate con attenzione nelle prossime ore. La seduta di rifinitura rappresenterà un passaggio importante per capire se l'ex Manchester City potrà partire con la squadra di Allegri oppure se sarà necessario concedergli un turno di riposo precauzionale. Al momento, infatti, non è da escludere una sua assenza contro i neroverdi. Lo staff medico seguirà con particolare attenzione l'evoluzione dell'affaticamento, evitando eventuali rischi che potrebbero compromettere ulteriormente la disponibilità del giocatore per i successivi impegni stagionali.

Dall'altra parte, anche il Sassuolo deve fare i conti con un'assenza pesante. I neroverdi hanno perso Vasilije Adžić, costretto a sottoporsi a un intervento chirurgico a Lione dopo il trauma contusivo-distorsivo al ginocchio destro rimediato durante Montenegro-Cipro. Gli accertamenti hanno evidenziato un piccolo distacco osteo-condrale e il trequartista di proprietà della Juventus ha già iniziato il percorso riabilitativo del caso. La sua assenza rappresenta una perdita veramente pesante per il nuovo tecnico Roberto D'Aversa, che dovrà rinunciare al talento classe 2006 probabilmente per l'intera seconda parte della stagione 2026-2027.

#165732. Xabi Alonso hits out at ‘soft’ Chelsea players

📅 12 Sep 2026 • ⏱️ 23m • 📚 Deep Dive (4624 w)
📖 Baca
General ⚖️ Neutral 🌐 Co ↗ Open Full Page

Xabi Alonso hits out at ‘soft’ Chelsea players

📅 12 Sep 2026 | ⏱️ 23 min read (4624 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Co

⏱️ ~23 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • Xabi Alonso accused his Chelsea players of being “soft” after they failed to keep a clean sheet for the 20th successive Premier League game.
  • Chelsea threw away an early lead to draw 2-2 with Hull City and have conceded two or more goals in each of their four Premier League games.
  • Alonso has tried different systems and different players in those games, but suggested Chelsea’s biggest problem is mental.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Xabi Alonso accused his Chelsea players of being “soft” after they failed to keep a clean sheet for the 20th successive Premier League game.

Chelsea threw away an early lead to draw 2-2 with Hull City and have conceded two or more goals in each of their four Premier League games.

Alonso has tried different systems and different players in those games, but suggested Chelsea’s biggest problem is mental.

The club’s dreadful clean-sheet record pre-dates him and is the first time in 65 years Chelsea have gone 20 league games without keeping the opposition out.

Hull’s first goal from Mohamed Belloumi came after the ball had bounced over Jorrel Hato and Alonso stated: “We need to be aware that from any situation, any team in the Premier League can hurt you. Today it was from a long ball, two bounces, the way it happened. You need to be very aware, very ready that the danger can come from any situation. If you are soft or if you are not prepared, you will get punished and we have been punished that way.”.

Chelsea have shared 30 goals with their opponents in the club’s six games in all competitions so far this season.

“Yeah, it’s all maybe entertaining, but I hope that one day you say it was a boring game and we win and we don’t give these entertaining moments,” he stated.

“But, for sure, it kind of repeats some patterns that we are making. It will take time to... or it will take moments to fix them when we get the lead and you still need to be competing and not give the chance so easily for them to come back, especially in the first goal, we can do much better.

Industry observers note that “It was too soft to give them this hope because until then we were controlling, we were creating chances. But that momentum that we had changed the mood and the score of the game, and it’s something that we need to be talking [about], we address and we will get better. But it’s having an impact on our performances at the moment.”.

According to recent reports, asked if his players have a real desire to defend and keep clean sheets, Alonso noted: “We can do better, we can do better for sure. We need to know that even when we have the lead, a very notable part of the game is to hold together, to keep the distance, to go intense in the situations to defend. I’m sure that we can do better.

Recent findings suggest that “Overall, I think that we are attacking better than defending in every part. We know that it’s a significant topic and a big theme for us. For sure, it’s just four games. But the dynamic in terms of conceding, I don’t like it and we need to do much better. Open play, set-pieces, long balls, this toughness, this competitive sense, we can do better.”.

Needing three goals or more to win games is not sustainable, as Chelsea manager Xabi Alonso is finding out.

In a recent development, this is not a problem of Alonso’s making, given Chelsea have now gone 20 Premier League games without a clean sheet. But he is certainly not improving the problem yet.

Chelsea beat Fulham with three goals and Brighton with four but left themselves far too much to do against Arsenal and were taken advantage of by Hull City, who will be slightly disappointed they did not leave Stamford Bridge with all three points.

Goalkeeper Emiliano Martínez has now conceded seven goals in three games since joining from Aston Villa, while central defender Maxence Lacroix, who joined for £52m from Crystal Palace in the summer, was relegated to the substitutes’ bench.

Martínez was at fault for Mohamed Belloumi’s second goal, but the Argentine did make a crucial save at his back post to stop substitute Mohamed-Ali Cho grabbing a winner that Chelsea could have had no complaints about.

Hull finished the game with more shots on goal than their hosts and a higher expected-goals rate. Chelsea are far too open and in some ways far too entertaining.

Defensive midfielder Moisés Caicedo cannot return from injury quickly enough, but this does not feel like a problem that will be solved by one man. Alonso needs to find a balance and instil a real desire in his team to defend.

Caicedo has that desire, but there are no defenders at the club who have shown that absolute desperation to keep the ball out of the net that Chelsea fans became so used to in the days of John Terry, Gary Cahill and César Azpilicueta.

Sources indicate that none of this should diminish Hull’s performance. They were not only spirited and full of character but also highlighted quality and a threat. The joke is currently on those who laughed at their hopes of survival before a ball had been kicked.

According to recent reports, it is now two wins and two draws for Sergej Jakirovic’s team and they are already a fifth of the way to 40 points. Jakirovic had promised his staff a week off in the international break if they reached eight points after five games. With that target already met, there may be a upcoming reward if Hull can make it 11 points against Newcastle United next weekend.

Recent findings suggest that “Before the season, I mentioned to my staff that we will take seven, eight points in these first five and then I will give them seven days off,” Jakirovic said. “That was our target and now we are in a very good position, eight points.

It has been revealed that “Especially today, it’s very, very difficult to play here, and now we will try to get even more. Of course, I’m a little bit worried about the international break because we have 13 national team players. But we will see who will come back and in what condition. So this is my concern right now.” Asked if his staff’s seven-day break will be extended if Hull can beat Newcastle, Jakirovic added: “I will tell them. But I know already.”.

While his five-game target may need modifying, Jakirovic is not deviating from his goal for the season for Hull. “Our target is always to stay in the league and collect as many points as possible,” he said. “Forty points, 38 to 41, this is the average we need. Then it’s easier to play. You can play more relaxed, with more joy and happiness. So [get to] this as soon as possible, so that we are safe.”.

Hull had not conceded a league goal before this and there had been predictions they might crumble when they finally let the ball into their net. They did so after just seven minutes but they kept their heads and came back stronger.

It was far too easy for Morgan Rogers to make a yard of space for himself to shoot after collecting the ball from João Pedro, and Hull goalkeeper Konstantinos Tzolakis may not have been happy to have been beaten at his near post.

It has been revealed that chelsea have now scored inside the first 10 minutes in all of their four league games, but Hull were in no mood to crumble and hit back with two goals in six minutes from Belloumi to take a half-time lead. Both Hull goals were shockers from Chelsea’s perspective. The first, in the 28th minute, came as a result of Jorrel Hato letting the ball bounce over him from a Ryan Giles cross and Belloumi finished brilliantly.

It has been revealed that belloumi’s second came after Martínez had flapped at a corner and Semi Ajayi had hit the bar with a header. The ball fell to Belloumi again and his shot was deflected into the net.

It was no surprise that Hato did not reappear for the second half, as he was replaced by Pep Chavarría at left-back. But Chelsea remained vulnerable and Martínez had to recover from spilling a Regan Slater shot to prevent Ollie McBurnie extending Hull’s advantage.

When Palmer and Pedro combined for Pedro to sweep the ball into the net and equalise with 24 minutes remaining, it seemed like it would be Chelsea who would provide the grandstand finish.

But it was Hull who got a second wind and Chelsea were indebted to Martínez for making a save to stop Cho securing all three points and sending the visiting fans home even happier.

I feel good. We have to be happy. It’s a huge result for us.

We had 2-1 at half-time and we had a 100 per cent chance with McBurnie but Martinez’s save was excellent. We have to control play better in the box because we can stop this [Chelsea goal]. We had an excellent chance for Cho – Martinez saved again. Player of the match.

Recent findings suggest that we can be very happy. We took a point in a very demanding match.

Industry observers note that eight points against very difficult opponents. We have to continue like this.

There have been 12 Premier League games at Anfield in 2026, Liverpool have only won 4 of them to date. This was seventh draw and Fulham deserves their share of the spoils. This was very much a learning experience for Andoni Iraola.

Not a single home win in the Premier League, today.

Aston Villa 1 Nottingham Forest 2Bournemouth 2 Brentford 2Chelsea 2 Hull City 2Crystal Palace 2 Ipswich Town 3Liverpool 0 Fulham 0.

What a result for Hull, who remain unbeaten and they have taken five points from fixtures against United, Villa and Chelsea.

That is the first really poor result of the Alonso era, points dropped.

What a thriller in SE25, both teams have been going for it in the closing stages, but Ipswich have surely score the winner through Zian Flemming.

Fulham were pointless before this game, but they have kept a clean sheet at Anfield with a disciplined display and they could well have score one or two. Underwhelming for Liverpool, who have not won just one of their first four games and their fixtures have not been the most taxing.

Industry observers note that and as we predicted at the beginning of the game... Liverpool 0 Fulham 0. If this reporter ever gives you advice on a horse to back or a team to follow, make sure you take the opposite stance. Fulham deserve their reward and their fans are singing “We got a point!”.

Villa are finishing the game with 10 men because Ian Maatsen pulled up after Emery had made his five substitutions, and Forest have punished them through Igor Jesus with just a few minutes of normal time to play.

It has been revealed that alexander Isak heads over the bar when he perhaps should have hit the target. Has time run out for Liverpool?

It has been revealed that you might imagine Chelsea are battering down the door, but Mohamed-Ali Cho has just forced Emi Martinez into a save at the other end. Hull will remain unbeaten if they can hold out.

Strand Larsen has had his critics, but he has scored his first goal of the season to set up a grandstand finish with 15 minutes plus stoppage time to play at Selhurst Park.

Short corner, McGinn whipped in an inswinging cross that is glanced into the bottom corner by Alysson.

Liverpool continue to toil at Anfield, but no opening goal. Iraola has thrown on Frimpong, Mac Allister, Ngumoha and Gakpo in the second half. Fulham have had the chances to score at least one, and Josh King has just brought a save out of Alisson.

Recent findings suggest that hull are a little lucky they still have 11 men on the pitch. Already on a booking, my man Crooks bundled down Rogers. It could easily have been another yellow car but the referee let him off and now he’s been replaced by Iroegbunam.

Joao Pedro finds the smallest of gaps to be the goalkeeper and find the roof of the net with a brilliant, instinctive finish.

That had not really been coming for Chelsea. It all felt a bit easy for Palmer to get his low cross into the box and Pedro to sweep the ball in. The home fans have woken up again.

Martinez was lucky to get away with another slip up, there. He spilt Slater’s shot but reacted before McBurnie to stop the Hull striker scoring the rebound. Just a day after his nasty looking crash, Sorba Thomas is on for Hull.

In a recent development, this game is absolutely here for Fulham to win. Quietness has descended around Anfield, the hosts have no fluency in their play and Fulham are growing in confidence. Why wouldn’t they after getting to 65 minutes with a clean sheet?

In a recent development, just like in the first half, four minutes after one of these teams taking the lead there has been an equaliser. Kevin Scahde is in a rich vein of form.

According to recent reports, bournemouth have have never beaten Brentford in the Premier League, but they might well be on their way to changing that record having trailed earlier in the game. Marcus Tavernier has just scored their second goal.

In a recent development, matt Davidson Rider Crooks has just been booked for a very cynical foul on Rogers. It gave Chelsea a free-kick in a dangerous position Reece James had an effort tipped away. Chelsea have started the second half well.

Within a minute of the restart, Villa lose the ball in midfield and Delap punishes them to the maximum. Cracking finish from just outside the box, and a much-needed goal by Delap. The Glasner curse striking for Emery again?

Liam Delap has just started paying back that £50m transfer fee with a fine goal.

Delap picked the ball up on the left and set himself up on the edge of the box before crashing a 25-yard shot past Zion Suzuki.

Unai Emery has made a couple of changes at half-time, taking off Nicolas Jackson who picked up a silly booking just before half-time.

In a recent development, tammy Abraham is on in his place. George Hemmings is also off and replaced by Alysson.

Pep Chavarria on for Chelsea at half-time. He’s replaced Jorrel Hato, who had a bit of a stinker in the first half.

Andoni Iraola hasn’t hung about here. Milos Kerkez has come on immediately after half-time for Kostas Tsimikas and you can say with certainty that Liverpool will be shopping for a new left-back in due course.

So at half-time, Hull City are top of the Premier League and don’t their supporters know it? They were singing “we are top of the League” for the full two minutes of time added on for stoppages at the end of the first period. Alonso has some work to do at the break.

Forest did need a brilliant double save from Matz Sels to deny Victor Lindelof and have recovered to slow the match down.

Neco Williams wasted a decent chance for Forest from outside the penalty area shortly before the break.

Referee Andrew Madley has irritated both teams with a number of weird decisions - but that’s sadly par for the course with officials nowadays.

Villa 0 Forest 0Bournemouth 1 Brentford 1Chelsea 1 Hull City 2Palace 1 Ipswich 2Liverpool 0 Fulham 0.

Palace in some trouble now, level with Ipswich and down to 10 men. Disasi was sent off in the 34th minute for a reckless challenge on Jack Clarke, caught him with studs on shin.

Things got worse for Palace just before half-time, with Leif Davis heading home at the back post to give Ipswich the league.

Apologies for the lack of updates, some technical gremlins at Telegraph Towers. A nip and tuck game as expected at at the Vitality: Kevin Schade gave Brentford the lead before Justin Kluivert equalised four minutes later.

One way to put it is that Kostas Tsimikas isn’t playing well. Another way to say it would be that his efforts are making Milos Kerkez look like Roberto Carlos. The Greek left-back is having a dreadful afternoon and Fulham are getting plenty of joy out of him. We suggested there was no chance of this game finishing goalless, and it’s anomalous that we have reached 40 minutes without score. Fulham, certainly, have a sense of adventure and have been into Liverpool’s 18-yard box plenty of times. Let’s see if the picture changes before the interval.

That’s now seven goals Emi Martinez has conceded in three games since joining from Villa to supposedly solve Chelsea’s goalkeeping crisis. Martinez won’t be pleased with Hull’s second goal, here. He was beaten to a corner by Ajayi. His header hit the bar and Belloumi’s shot was deflected past him. The Hull fans are in dreamland.

Recent findings suggest that this is a turn up for the books. Chelsea undone by a long ball forward, and Hato lets the ball bounce over his head, and Belloumi finishes with aplomb.

Industry observers note that that’s now 20 Premier League games Chelsea have gone without keeping a clean sheet. What an earth was Jorrel Hato doing, letting the ball bounce over him for Belloumi? Amateur stuff at the back from the home side. It was Hull’s first meaningful attack.

Emersonn has struggled in some games so far this season, but he has just planted a header into the corner from a Davis cross.

There is a VAR check for offside... but the goal stands.

It has been revealed that 5 - Morgan Rogers is the fifth different player to score or assist in each of Chelsea's first four games of a Premier League season, after Didier Drogba (2010-11), Cesc Fàbregas (2014-15), Diego Costa (2014-15 & 2016-17), and Eden Hazard (2018-19).Famous. pic.twitter.com/0cuThzH472.

Recent findings suggest that A sweet strike from one of Palace’s summer signings, recruited from Union Saint Gilloise, and that is his first Palace goal. The 22-year-old Israeli came through at Maccabi Haifa. Uphill task for Gary O’Neill and Ipswich.

Austin MacPhee, Chelsea’s flamboyant set-piece coach, just motioned for Xabi Alonso to sit down when the Blues manager momentarily got up from his seat when the home side were preparing to take a corner. It seems MacPhee wears the (correct length) trousers when it comes to set pieces.

An almighty let off for Alisson and Liverpool after pass from the goalkeeper played Gravenberch into trouble, but Jacquet cleared off the line to keep the game goalless. That was Fulham’s first foray forward.

It has been revealed that A bright start in this game and there is no chance it will end goalless (famous last words). Andoni Iraola has made three changes from the team that beat Atletico Madrid on Wednesday and it’s a pattern of his early management that he is making the kind of decisions that supporters are nodding along in approval with. Liverpool should already be one up but Alexander Isak’s shot has just drifted across the face of goal but the signs are encouraging. It could be a long afternoon for Alvaro Arbeloa.

Wow. Unbelievable double save from Forest’s Matz Sels there to keep out Victor Lindelof.

The first was the most impressive, a reflex stop after a deflection.

Sources indicate that morgan Rogers is the first player to score against Hull City this season. Emi Martinez launched the ball forward after claiming a corner, and Rogers’ shot from the edge of the area crept under the goalkeeper Tzolakis. He will not want to watch that one again.

We’re past five minutes and it’s the longest Chelsea have gone without scoring in the league this season. Back on Matt Crooks – one of his middle names is Rider.

In a recent development, although Rogers scored in the seventh minute...so the early goals continue for Chelsea. It will be difficult for Hull now.

Twelve seconds in and the chant “where were you in Istanbul” gets a very early airing from Villa’s home fans.

That is of course a reference to Villa’s 4-0 win over Forest in the Europa League semi-final second leg last season.

The early indications are that Reece James is playing in midfield with Malo Gusto at right-back in a conventional back four.

Industry observers note that xabi Alonso has made an encouraging start to life as Chelsea manager. But his trousers upset me. They are three inches too short and a bit baggy above the ankle.

We are under way in the five Premier League 3pm kick-offs. Goals and further updates from around the grounds as they happen.

Some early #analysis from Matt at the Bridge, about one of Hull’s midfielders.

Matt Crooks is absolutely massive.

One player who has really shone for Villa so far this season is teenage midfielder George Hemmings.

Unai Emery has been very impressed with the academy graduate, who made his Champions League debut on Tuesday night.

There is also a major buzz around £51m signing Johan Manzambi, who is on the bench today after recovering from a knee injury.

Will we get another fast start from Chelsea today? They have scored inside the first five minutes in all three of their League games this season. Hull are yet to concede.

Dominic King writes that there were signs of promise in the relationship between Barcola, Wirtz and Isak in Liverpool’s win over Atletico Madrid, and all three forwards start against Fulham. Timothy Castagne, Fulham’s right-back will need to have his sprinting boots on against Barcola, who is grease lightning.

Cole Palmer has 15 goal involvements in his 15 Premier League games for Chelsea against newly promoted sides.9 goals ⚽6 assists 🅰️ pic.twitter.com/PJIU0YxIhQ.

According to recent reports, I’m having real fun. I’ve got a smile on face and I’m enjoying my football. Playing with players like [Palmer and Joao Pedro] inspire you to be better and make you do better and do well for the team. We are in a good moment and we want to keep it going.

It has been revealed that hull are really tough to beat. They have played against some good opponents and they’ve kept them out - they haven’t conceded yet. It is going to be difficult because they are really organised but we are at home and it is on us to make the game about us.

We know it is always tough against Brentford. We can expect a tight game today, definitely. We both want to win so it’ll be a nice game.

Sources indicate that we are very excited about our first European game coming up but we haven’t really spoken about it lately because we have just spoken about this game. This is a big game and we are looking for our first three points of the season. We have been close in every game so we hope to get it today.

Unai Emery is possibly the best coach in the Premier League but has found past encounters with Oliver Glasner very uncomfortable.

Since Glasner’s arrival in English football with Crystal Palace in February 2024, he has faced Emery’s Villa seven times and never lost.

With five victories and two draws, it is an impressive record albeit with a different set of players.

Aston Villa and Forest are two teams in transition, and meet for the first time since that two-legged Europa League semi-final last season.

Villa are building a upcoming chapter after a summer of significant change, while Forest are implementing a totally different style of play under Oliver Glasner.

It has been revealed that there have been signs of progress at both of the former European Cup winners. Villa secured an impressive victory over Club Brugge in the Champions League on Tuesday. Forest are improving under Glasner, with their best performance the 2-2 draw at Liverpool.

Returning to Villa Park will have some bitter memories for a number of the Forest players, after that 4-0 defeat in the second leg of the Europa League.

Published: 17:50 EST, 24 November 2026 | Updated: 17:54 EST, 24 November 2026.

Bruno Fernandes has left the door open for a return to Sporting Lisbon amid increasing uncertainty over his future at Manchester United.

Fernandes was a fans’ favourite at Sporting before joining United in January 2020 in a deal worth up to £68million.

The United captain has become equally popular at Old Trafford, but returned to Lisbon on Tuesday night with a question mark hanging over his next move after talks over a new contract stalled.

Fernandes’ current deal is due to run out at the end of June – and he will be able to speak to foreign clubs from January 1 – although United are expected to trigger an automatic 12-month extension to prevent him from leaving as a free agent in the summer.

According to recent reports, asked if he would consider a move back to the Jose Alvalade Stadium, where United meet Sporting in the Champions League on Wednesday night, Fernandes said: ‘I will never close the door to Sporting. It will always be a club with a special place in my heart.

Industry observers note that ‘Sporting was the first club that believed in my potential. I’ve always felt here from the fans – regardless of what may have happened – all the love and kindness from them, and that was essential to make me grow as a player.’.

Bruno Fernandes has rejected two offers of a upcoming contract to extend his stay at Man United.

On his future at Old Trafford, Fernandes insisted that he wants to focus on turning United’s season around after they slipped into the relegation zone and replaced head coach Michael Carrick with Mauricio Pochettino.

It has been revealed that ‘We have time to speak about that,’ stated Fernandes. ‘I know it's my future and I probably shouldn't look that way because I haven't got long left, but I'm more worried about results.

Recent findings suggest that ‘Contract talks have stopped for us to start winning games, and then we can talk about a contract. Now is not the moment.’.

Brutte notizie per Cristian Chivu in vista dei prossimi impegni dell'Inter. Gli accertamenti clinici e strumentali ai quali si è sottoposto questo venerdì mattina Alessandro Bastoni presso l'Istituto Humanitas di Rozzano hanno evidenziato un risentimento al quadricipite della coscia sinistra. Il difensore, che ha accusato il problema durante la gara di Champions League contro lo Stoccarda, dovrà rimanere ai box per un periodo che, secondo le prime indicazioni, dovrebbe aggirarsi intorno alle tre settimane. La società nerazzurra non ha comunque comunicato ufficialmente i tempi di recupero.

Il possibile rientro di Bastoni è fissato al momento per il 22 dicembre, quando l'Inter affronterà la Lazio nella semifinale di Supercoppa Italiana. Prima di quella data, il difensore ex Atalanta e Parma rischia di saltare ben sei appuntamenti: Genoa in campionato e in Coppa Italia, Frosinone, Borussia Dortmund in Champions League, Torino e Lecce.

In a recent development, non sono arrivate però soltanto notizie negative dall'allenamento di qualche ora fa. Piotr Zielinski ha infatti lavorato regolarmente in gruppo, tornando a disposizione di mister Chivu per la gara di domenica contro il Genoa di De Rossi, in programma a San Siro. L'infiammazione al piede, una sospetta fascite plantare, sembra dunque dare finalmente tregua al centrocampista nerazzurro, costretto a rinunciare in precedenza agli impegni con Atalanta e Stoccarda.

Industry News: Pep Guardiola names three former midfielders he expects to become good managers, including an ex-Man City player

💡 Key Takeaways
  • By Axel Clody | 26 Nov 2026 09:15.
  • Pep Guardiola believes that midfielders have characteristics that can make the transition from the pitch to the technical area easier.
  • In an interview with Romario TV, the former Manchester City manager spoke about players who, in his view, have the potential to build a successful career as managers, and highlighted the broader vision of the game that the position requires.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

By Axel Clody | 26 Nov 2026 09:15.

Pep Guardiola believes that midfielders have characteristics that can make the transition from the pitch to the technical area easier.

In an interview with Romario TV, the former Manchester City manager spoke about players who, in his view, have the potential to build a successful career as managers, and highlighted the broader vision of the game that the position requires.

In a recent development, among the names mentioned are Ilkay Gundogan, Sergio Busquets and Xabi Alonso, all with midfield experience and different trajectories in football. When asked about former players who could follow in his footsteps on the touchline, Guardiola was direct in naming his picks.

In a recent development, 'I think Gundogan will be a good manager... Busquets will be a good manager. I knew Xabi Alonso would become a good manager.'.

The statement brings together three players who played crucial roles in elite teams and who, during their careers, played in roles that demanded game reading, tactical understanding and the ability to organise collective actions.

The choice of names follows the central idea presented by the manager. For Guardiola, experience as a midfielder can offer an especially favourable base for those who want to lead a team. That is because the position requires involvement at different moments of the match, in both attacking build-up and defensive organisation, as well as a constant understanding of the positioning of team-mates and opponents.

Recent findings suggest that guardiola explained why he sees an advantage in players who operate in that area. In the Catalan's view, the role demands a reading that goes beyond individual participation, as the midfielder needs to understand how the team moves and what each moment of the match requires.

'I think midfielders have an advantage because they need to have a more global understanding of the game' - he noted.

Sources indicate that the manager deepened his reasoning by drawing a comparison with forwards. 'They have to make the team play and understand which areas to defend. A forward often just thinks: "I am going to score a goal, and that is it."'.

The observation is not a criticism of forwards, but highlights the difference in responsibilities between the positions.

While a forward can concentrate much of his performance on finishing and the pursuit of goals, the midfielder needs to follow the collective dynamic, identify spaces, take part in ball circulation and understand the movements required to protect the team without possession.

It has been revealed that the three names cited by the manager have trajectories that help explain his assessment. Gundogan worked with Guardiola at Manchester City, while Busquets was a key part of Barcelona during the period when Guardiola managed the team. Xabi Alonso, meanwhile, was coached by Guardiola at Bayern Munich.

What they have in common, beyond the position, is that all three built careers marked by the ability to interpret the game and make decisions in different tactical contexts.

Sources indicate that in Alonso's case, Guardiola had already shown this perception before the former midfielder began his managerial career. The Spaniard retired as a player in 2017 and later rose to prominence in charge of Bayer Leverkusen, work that reinforced the bet made by his former manager.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

In casa Napoli si lavora al mercato e la priorità è regalare ad Allegri un vice-Hojlund, un calciatore che possa dare ricambio in maniera consistente al danese e allo stesso tempo eventualmente giocare insieme.

Sources indicate that il club sembra intenzionato a puntare sull’attaccante campano Sebastiano Esposito, attualmente in prestito al Sassuolo, ma di proprietà del Cagliari. Il calciatore è il profilo adatto, per caratteristiche e cifre, per sostituire Lorenzo Lucca, sempre più ai margini e ormai giocatore che verrà ceduto a gennaio. La trattativa tra le parti è già cominciata e il Napoli sembra intenzionato a sferrare a gennaio l’attacco decisivo per Esposito.

Come riporta Il Mattino il Napoli è in pole per Sebastiano Esposito, nelle ultime settimane l’agente del giocatore Giuffredi ha incontrato Giovanni Manna e la trattativa è stata ormai già preimpostata. Il presidente azzurro De Laurentiis vuole riportare l’attaccante in Campania e il giocatore può arrivare a costi piuttosto contenuti per un profilo da Nazionale.

Il Sassuolo può riscattare Esposito per 10 milioni di euro circa e il Napoli potrebbe chiudere la trattativa a circa 14-15 milioni di euro, una trattativa che il Napoli potrebbe realizzare anche in prestito con obbligo di riscatto a fine anno. Le parti ragionano sul da farsi, ma sarà Esposito il nuovo attaccante per gennaio.

In quella partita ha ripetuto un errore già commesso in altre situazioni, quel calo di concentrazione che a volte hanno le squadre forti, che pensano magari di avere già la vittoria in tasca. Non penso che per questi motivi lo scudetto sia a rischio, ma la squadra deve migliorare sotto questo aspetto, perché non può permettersi di continuare a commettere queste ingenuità, dovute più a cali di attenzione che a una mancanza di qualità.

In a recent development, quella partita le è costata anche Calhanoglu, che si è fermato di nuovo, stavolta per un problema al flessore, e salterà la sfida con il Genoa: al suo posto è entrato Sucic, che poi ha segnato su rigore. Penso che Calhanoglu sia un giocatore fondamentale per l'Inter, ma è altrettanto vero che a centrocampo la squadra ha diversi giocatori in grado di fare bene e di mettere qualità, esperienza e voglia di vincere al servizio dei compagni. Sucic è uno di questi: ha un enorme potenziale e gli va data la fiducia giusta per rendere al 100%.

Recent findings suggest that dall'altra parte De Rossi ha raccontato che l'inizio di questa stagione è stato forse il momento più difficile della sua carriera e ha ringraziato il Genoa, che ha vinto quattro delle ultime cinque partite, per avergli dato «fiducia e pazienza» in un momento in cui altri club non ne hanno molta. Ha ragione, e ne sono felicissimo, perché è ancora una volta la dimostrazione che chi ha fiducia e pazienza può ottenere dei risultati. Oggi, dal mio punto di vista, il Genoa è la squadra gestita meglio: non si è fatto prendere dallo sconforto per tutte quelle sconfitte, non ha messo in discussione l'allenatore e gli ha sempre dato la fiducia necessaria per fare un ottimo lavoro. Adesso ne sta traendo beneficio, con punti e vittorie importanti. La pazienza che il Genoa ha avuto con De Rossi è purtroppo un'eccezione, in Italia ma ormai anche altrove, e deve servire da lezione alle tante società che non hanno mai la pazienza di lavorare con l'allenatore che hanno scelto anche nei momenti di difficoltà".

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

By Matt Law | 26 Nov 2026 09:21, Last updated: 26 Nov 2026 09:29.

Anthony Gordon scored twice in Barcelona's 4-1 win over Sabah in the league stage of the Champions League on Wednesday night.

In doing so, Gordon made history - the forward has now scored six Champions League goals in Azerbaijan, which is the most any English player has netted in away games in one country in the tournament.

Four of the England international's goals in Azerbaijan came against Qarabag during his time with Newcastle United, before scoring twice against Sabah on Wednesday.

Lamine Yamal missed out through injury, while Raphinha was rested from the start, with Gordon joined by Karim Adeyemi and Gabriel Jesus in the final third, and all three found the back of the net.

As expected, Gordon's performance brought a lot of praise from the Spanish media.

Sources indicate that 6 - Anthony Gordon's six UEFA Champions League goals in Azerbaijan are the most any English player has scored in away games in one country in the competition. Tourist. https://t.co/7OfdYkdzch.

AS were extremely positive about Gordon's performance, saying that the forward was 'vital' to Barcelona securing all three points in the Champions League.

Mundo Deportivo also highlighted how well he combined with Gabriel Jesus and Adeyemi in the final third of the field in the absence of Yamal and Raphinha.

La Vanguardia concentrated on how Gordon became the main player in the Barcelona attack and said that he was one of the main reasons why Hansi Flick's side were able to score four goals.

Culemania said that Gordon 'stepped into Raphinha's shoes', having netted twice in the absence of the Brazil international, who has scored 19 times in all competitions this season.

Gordon will never be the main man in the Barcelona attack due to the presence of both Yamal and Raphinha, but he has played an crucial supporting role this term.

The 25-year-old's numbers for this season are relatively solid, coming up with five goals and five assists in 17 appearances in all competitions.

In La Liga, Gordon has two goals and five assists in 12 appearances, while he has struck three times in five outings in the Champions League.

The forward will be looking to improve his goal total in Spain's top flight, but it has been a positive start to his Barcelona career for the former Everton youngster.

By Carter White | 26 Nov 2026 09:38.

Dominic Calvert-Lewin has reportedly signed a newly introduced Leeds United contract running until the summer of 2029.

Daniel Farke's side have continued their excellent start to the 2026-27 campaign following the November international break, recording a 4-1 success at the Stamford Bridge home of Chelsea on Saturday afternoon.

As a result of Lukas Nmecha and company collecting maximum points from the West London contest, the Elland Road club have stayed in seventh position in the Premier League standings, on the coattails of the Champions League conversation.

The main man in attack for Leeds in recent times, Calvert-Lewin has made a positive start to the season, with the 29-year-old Leeds star supposedly wanted by relegation-threatened Manchester United.

Nevertheless, the England international will be fully focused on helping Farke's troops qualify for European competition this term, with the Whites welcoming Coventry City to Yorkshire on Saturday.

According to The Athletic's Beren Cross via transfer expert Fabrizio Romano, Leeds United supporters have been given a major piece of positive news regarding the future of leading marksman Calvert-Lewin.

The report claims that the 29-year-old has agreed to an extension of his current terms at Elland Road, with the Three Lions appearance-maker originally joining on a free transfer from Everton in August 2025.

It is understood that Calvert-Lewin's fresh deal will run until the conclusion of the 2028-29 campaign, at which point the striker will be heading towards his mid-30s and the twilight of his career.

Before Leeds can officially announce the news surrounding the forward, it is believed that they must complete 'formal steps', with everyone involved in the process expecting a smooth process in that respect.

Either side of the November international break, Calvert-Lewin's side have recorded back-to-back wins over Tottenham Hotspur and Chelsea, proving their strength against some of the Premier League's biggest names.

Part of the furniture in the Premier League since the 2017-18 campaign, Calvert-Lewin has been the classic example of a confidence and purple-patch striker, with the attacker's form swinging dramatically.

This season, the 29-year-old is arguably churning out the best performances of his top-flight career to date, scoring five goals and providing one assist during the opening 11 Premier League games.

Whilst Leeds are known to be in the market for another striker ahead of the January window, there is no desire to replace Calvert-Lewin in the starting XI, as is clear with a contract extension on the table.

Liverpool: With Isak and Wirtz, the Reds’ transfer business takes off a year late

⏱️ ~2 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • By Axel Clody | 26 Nov 2026 09:44.
  • During the 2025 summer transfer window, Liverpool broke the bank, spending £410m.
  • Alexander Isak and Florian Wirtz were the two most expensive signings, as the Swedish striker arrived for £123m (€145m) and the German attacking midfielder for £106m (€125m).
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

By Axel Clody | 26 Nov 2026 09:44.

During the 2025 summer transfer window, Liverpool broke the bank, spending £410m.

Alexander Isak and Florian Wirtz were the two most expensive signings, as the Swedish striker arrived for £123m (€145m) and the German attacking midfielder for £106m (€125m). But for many months, the two most expensive recruits in the club's history failed to live up to expectations.

In his first season at Liverpool, Wirtz scored seven goals and provided 10 assists in 49 games, but his impact was largely disappointing. Isak, for his part, barely played (four goals and one assist in 22 games) because of a fractured fibula. That summer 2025 transfer window was thus described as 'the worst transfer window in Premier League history'.

Both attackers were therefore expected to deliver in their second season at Liverpool, with newly introduced manager Andoni Iraola arriving.

The momentum is completely different at the start of this campaign, as the 3-0 win over Club Brugge on Wednesday night in the Champions League illustrated perfectly. Isak scored twice, while Wirtz also found the net.

The Swede is rediscovering the efficiency that made his reputation at Newcastle United. He now has ten goals in all competitions in 16 games and has just scored in six consecutive away games for Liverpool. The 27-year-old is establishing himself as the number nine Liverpool had long been waiting for.

On Wednesday night, Isak was asked about when he would be back at his best level: 'It is always difficult to say, but I can definitely say that I feel good, the team is in a good rhythm, that is the most vital thing' - he mentioned.

After a season of adaptation to English football, in which he struggled to have an impact in the final third and to be decisive, Wirtz is in excellent form.

Still deployed as a number 10, the 23-year-old German has scored four goals and provided five assists in 17 games in all competitions for Liverpool.

According to recent reports, his November has been excellent: three goals and two assists in three games for Liverpool, as well as three goals in two games for the German national team. Wirtz appears to have digested his huge transfer and to be ready to shed his 'flop' label at Liverpool.

The two things Roberto De Zerbi demanded from Luca Williams-Barnett's first Tottenham start as 18-year-old star signs new lucrative deal, writes MATT BARLOW

💡 Key Takeaways
  • Published: 08:08 EST, 22 November 2026 | Updated: 18:17 EST, 24 November 2026.
  • Having summoned Luca Williams-Barnett to his office to let the teenager know he would be making his first Premier League start, Roberto De Zerbi could not resist a little bit of fun.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

By MATT BARLOW, FOOTBALL WRITER.

Published: 08:08 EST, 22 November 2026 | Updated: 18:17 EST, 24 November 2026.

Having summoned Luca Williams-Barnett to his office to let the teenager know he would be making his first Premier League start, Roberto De Zerbi could not resist a little bit of fun.

De Zerbi cast a serious demeanour and told him he had weighed the options and figured the best course of action would be 60 minutes with the Under-21s.

Williams-Barnett did not hide his disappointment. 'Why, do you think you are ready to start for the first team?' asked the Spurs boss. The 18-year-old said he thought so.

De Zerbi cracked a smile and told him he was in the team against Ipswich but demanded two things in return.

First, that his young star would play with freedom as though 'in the park with friends' and second that he would work without the ball in the manner of the world's best players in his position, such as Lamine Yamal.

This is where the comparisons to Yamal emerged soon after Williams-Barnett lit up the Tottenham Hotspur Stadium. On Tuesday, he was rewarded for his progress with a new contract at the club.

He noted: 'This is a special moment for me and my family, and one I have worked really hard to reach. But this is only the start.

Luca Williams-Barnett scored his first Premier League goal for Tottenham on his first start in the top flight.

The talented academy youngster may not be lightning fast but he has pace and creates goals.

'Spurs is a family to me. I've been here for so long – it's a second home, where I trust the people and coaches who have pushed me to become the player I am today.

'The club has trusted and believed in me, now I'm ready to repay that.'.

It has been revealed that hopes are indeed high. Similarities with Yamal are evident in physique, his fluency of movement on the ball and the bursts of pace, the way they look to play. Even the hairstyle.

Just as Yamal, a left footer, likes to operate wide on the right for Barcelona and Spain, De Zerbi deployed Williams-Barnett as a right footer on the left, although most of his youth career has been spent centrally in the No 10 position.

Sources indicate that he does not possess what you would consider in modern football to be exceptional pace, but he is quick, and his strengths are on the ball. He likes the ball. He creates. And he scores goals.

From wide on the left against Ipswich, he scored within 15 minutes, darting in at the back post to finish, and created the second for Dominic Solanke, with a 60-yard run from inside his own half and cross with his left foot.

His brilliance lit up the Tottenham Hotspur Stadium, where there has not been a lot to celebrate in the last 18 months. Terrible home form was the crux of last season's relegation fears.

According to recent reports, here, they rose to salute a latest talent, one of their own. One De Zerbi believes has the attitude to match his outrageous talent. Confident, certainly. Aware of his natural gifts and his technical skills. Perhaps bordering on arrogance when on the pitch.

De Zerbi was pleased to see Williams-Barnett, in a seat nearby on the team bus from the training ground to the stadium, watching YouTube clips of Ronaldinho, Eden Hazard and Neymar.

According to recent reports, the Spurs boss, who has faith in the power of inspirational video footage, took this as a positive sign. The youngster was relaxed but more than this he had a passion for football and always looking to learn.

'I'm positive about his character and behaviour because I've been working with him for three or four months and I know him enough,' remarked De Zerbi, whose tactical instructions involved James Maddison operating closely to Williams-Barnett, a kindred spirit in a footballing sense able to talk him through the game.

When the teenager set off on the swaggering run for Solanke's goal, Maddison could be seen nearby urging him forward into the ocean of space left open by Ipswich.

The 18-year-old had rival clubs circling but Spurs have now tied him down.

Born and raised in Luton, Williams-Barnett comes from a strong, grounded family - which will only help as he looks to assimilate into the senior side.

Sources indicate that spurs have prioritised Premier League experience in the transfer market under De Zerbi to create a more mature dressing room environment. Signings such as Andy Robertson have been key to this.

The policy is not purely for the benefit of academy graduates stepping into the first-team environment, but it does help when it comes to setting the standards required in elite sport.

Anyone gifted enough to break into the Spurs squad will have been feted as a star through the youth development phase and well rewarded to resist others trying to lure them away.

Williams-Barnett was under contract until 2028 but his new deal means clubs circling must now look elsewhere.

It is easy for impressionable teens to become conceited in this situation. Williams-Barnett has had discipline and time-keeping issues but most at Spurs speak of a young man devoted to his football from a strong, loving family who are sure to keep him grounded.

He was born and raised in Luton, starting out in Luton Town's pre-academy to Under 10s, before Spurs paid a small fee for him.

His father Jonathan Barnett was a central midfielder in Step Three of non-league football, known as 'Jono' and playing for various clubs in the region including Dunstable Town and Arlesey Town and renowned for his passing, set pieces and with an eye for goal.

Recent findings suggest that although more of a dribbler, Luca grew up with football in the family, polishing his technical skills with his dad in the back garden. 'He is from a very good family and it's crucial for this type of players,' remarked De Zerbi.

Spurs have been here before, of course, with talented teens breaking through with N17 at their feet.

There was Mikey Moore's wonderful cameo against AZ Alkmaar after which Ange Postecoglou called for patience and commonsense, and Maddison went on TV and remarked it was 'like having Neymar on the left wing'.

There was Jose Mourinho taking the match ball from Son Heung-min, who had just scored the most incredible solo goal against Burnley, and handing it to Troy Parrott on his Premier League debut.

In a recent development, there was Mauricio Pochettino dubbing Marcus Edwards his 'mini Messi'. Pochettino soon came to wish he had not burdened Edwards with such lavish praise.

Industry observers note that the pitfalls are well known and progress is rarely a smooth upward trajectory. It is a balancing act between maximising potential and getting carried away.

De Zerbi is quietly confident Williams-Barnett has what it takes to handle the hype.

On the fresh deal, thought to be for five years, the manager said: 'Luca is a player I think the world of, and I'm so happy that he has signed a new contract.

'He has benefitted from being around the first team every day, growing in stature and consistency, and has deserved his place in the matchday squad over recent weeks.

'Everyone can see how technically gifted Luca is on the pitch but I also love his calmness and decision-making under pressure.

'The best players have confidence on the pitch and humility off it. There is still plenty of room for Luca to improve, and I know he will continue to work hard every day to be the best version of himself.'.

Tottenham Hotspur have never before in the club’s history begun a league season without scoring a single goal in the first four games, although having done so after spending £329m on newly introduced players really does take some doing.

According to recent reports, “Please score a goal!” was the homemade sign from two Spurs fans upon which the television cameras lingered at the end of the game, although the jaunty felt-tip design and glued-on team crest were rather upbeat compared to the gloom of the stadium. Spurs have tried to outrun their past but it just keeps catching up with them.

Sources indicate that A team reimagined, a manager freshly launched and yet they are back in the same grip of anxiety that accompanied them on two consecutive 17th-place finishes in the last two seasons. By the end of this they might have been glad to escape with a single point against Everton, the one team in the Premier League who closed the window with a net transfer profit.

According to recent reports, for Roberto De Zerbi, there was another passionate defence of his team afterwards. “The people, the fans already understand if I make excuses or not,” he said. “I came last season when the s--- was like this”, he gestured to a level somewhere around the midpoint of his forehead. “I have always been… not positive but realistic. I am sorry for the result that it’s not immediately the improvement. We played as a team. We didn’t score. We didn’t win [but] we played as a team.”.

Indeed he co-opted the Italian term “sbloccare” to describe his team’s problem. They simply need to unlock – or unblock – the team and the goals would flow. He joked that in Italy he would be lauded for two consecutive clean sheets in this game and the previous one against Nottingham Forest. “What did you write?” he demanded of one of the Italian newspaper correspondents. “You have the passport.”.

Spurs have one last game at home this month, on Saturday against Aston Villa, to end the streak in September. They were into the second half before the first attempt on target that obliged Jordan Pickford to make a save – Mateus Fernandes’s shot slapping limply against the Everton goalkeeper’s gloves to ironic cheers from the home fans.

At the end De Zerbi could not contain his frustration, unable to wait until he reached the privacy of the dressing room to tell Mathys Tel where he had gone wrong. He did so with the Spurs substitute still wiping the sweat from his brow on the pitch. The player did not look at all impressed. De Zerbi said later that he was simply reminding his player of what it took to play as a central striker.

“There is a term in Italian, ‘sbloccare’ that literally translates as ‘unblock’… I know we can score goals and win games. We have to respect the history of the players – if you forget [Dominic] Solanke and [Omar] Marmoush the others haven’t scored many in their careers. I think we can find the goals with the quality of the players.”.

According to recent reports, spurs play Liverpool at Anfield in the Carabao Cup on Tuesday before Villa a week today. The Spurs record at home is dismal. In the last 35 games they have won just five, drawn 10 and lost a remarkable 20. This new stadium has become a problem for the team in it – or maybe it is the other way around.

A good result for Everton, who were under pressure for most of the first half but had much the better of it after the break. David Moyes’s team finished the game with more shots on target than the home team. Moyes managed the game well and trusted his team to withstand the Spurs possession in the first half until they reached a point where Everton could start to push back.

Industry observers note that hard to pick out any major chances – it was that kind of game – but Brennan Johnson should have won it for the away team in the second half. The ball was cut back to him by Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall and the former Spurs man skied his shot.

According to recent reports, some surprised faces then when Moyes noted later that he had expected a lot more from his team. He acknowledged the resilience in defence and the importance of the clean sheet. “We played well enough,” he said, “but when we had the ball we turned it over more often than we should have done.”.

The game had started with Vitaliy Mykolenko being tortured by the pace of Sávio and ended with the Ukrainian left-back being given the man of the match award. Like many of his team-mates, he had hung in there. There was another fine performance from Jarrad Branthwaite at centre-half and Moyes remarked that he hoped it might earn him a place in the England squad. “He is still finding his way back from injury,” Moyes said, “it would be great if he could get a call-up.”.

In the directors’ box were the usual pained expressions of Vinai Venkatesham, the Spurs chief executive, and chairman Peter Charrington. They sat alongside Vivienne Lewis, daughter of the patriarch Joe. There is a certain fatigue about the home crowd when faced with afternoons like this which suggests they have seen so much that the bar is quite high – or low – to provoke a really splenetic response. Perhaps it is just too early in the season although the final whistle was met with boos.

The first shot on target of the entire game for either side was a free-kick struck by James Garner in added time at the end of the first half. Spurs had started at a ferocious pace although they could not sustain it.

In a recent development, de Zerbi complained about the pre-season injuries on tour in Australia and also the lack of time he had to integrate Sávio and Marmoush. He noted that his team were not in the right “physical condition”.

It has been revealed that “We played very well in the first 30 minutes and maybe the energy and the fact we didn’t score – we lost confidence.” By the end, he had sent on James Maddison, Tel, Lucas Bergvall and Mohammed Kudus to little avail. Everton looked more likely to win it.

According to recent reports, speaking to Sky Sports, the Everton defender said: “You look at the game from the start, they put us under pressure and we had to dig deep to stay in the game. Then we grew into the game towards the end of the first half and indicated that mentality again in the second half.

“We had chances to win the game as well. The backs to the wall mentality will help us go a long way. If we can keep clean sheets, you can go a long way in the league. But it’s not just us the defenders. It’s the whole team working hard. It’s a team effort.”.

"I feel like we could've taken three points" James Tarkowski speaks after his sides draw with Spurs 🎙️ pic.twitter.com/Wdj3N5hk8l.
